{{Infobox award
| awarded_for = "the finest books and reviews published in English"
| sponsor = [[National Book Critics Circle]]
| firstawarded = 1976
}}The '''National Book Critics Circle Award for Fiction''', established in 1976,<ref name="newsletter1976">[http://bookcritics.org/images/uploads/vol2no1spring1976.pdf ''The National Book Critics Circle Journal'' 2:1, Spring 1976] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110519124331/http://bookcritics.org/images/uploads/vol2no1spring1976.pdf|date=May 19, 2011}}, NBCC. Retrieved February 2, 2012.</ref> is an annual American [[literary award]] presented by the [[National Book Critics Circle]] (NBCC) to promote "the finest books and reviews published in English."<ref>{{Cite web|title=How We Pick Our Awards|url=https://www.bookcritics.org/awards/selection/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200608004545/https://www.bookcritics.org/awards/selection/|url-status=dead|archive-date=June 8, 2020|access-date=January 24, 2022|website=National Book Critics Circle}}</ref>

Books previously published in English are not eligible, such as re-issues and paperback editions. They do consider "translations, short story and essay collections, self-published books, and any titles that fall under the general categories."<ref name="FAQ">{{Cite web|title=Frequently Asked Questions|url=https://www.bookcritics.org/faq/|access-date=January 24, 2022|website=National Book Critics Circle|archive-date=January 24, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220124225950/https://www.bookcritics.org/faq/|url-status=live}}</ref>

The judges are the volunteer directors of the NBCC who are 24 members serving rotating three-year terms, with eight elected annually by the voting members, namely "professional book review editors and book reviewers."<ref>{{Cite web|title=Membership|url=https://www.bookcritics.org/membership/|access-date=January 24, 2022|website=National Book Critics Circle|archive-date=January 25, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220125015908/https://www.bookcritics.org/membership/|url-status=live}}</ref> Winners of the awards are announced each year at the NBCC awards ceremony in conjunction with the yearly membership meeting, which takes place in March.<ref name="FAQ" />
